notes: The San Francisco Call of Sunday 25 March 1906, the one issue of January-March 1906 the bulk route holds (reel 00100480748 inside curiv_jenner_ver01), read on the 1910-1913 real-estate method. The issue has no Building Contracts list - the list ran Monday to Saturday - so its real-estate news is the Sunday column on p. 54, 'Big Realty Deals Mark Busy Week': the week's sales by broker, a Richmond and Sunset lot-sales list, and a string of leases. Taken: sales that say something about a building (its form, storeys, use or name), leases that name a building or a firm, and one grading event. Left out at extraction: private buyers, sellers and lessees, estates named for them, and the buyers in the Richmond and Sunset lot lists. One notable past owner is kept, Mrs. I. Magnin, in extra.notable_owner. Pre-fire: of the 26 findings, 15 describe property in the district that burned on 18-20 April 1906 and are left unresolved under the LESSONS.md rule for pre-fire records there.

coverage.remaining: Nothing of January-March 1906 is left on the bulk route: this is its only issue. The dossier's next items are the 1907-1913 refused single candidates and the 1897-1899 and 1903-1904 scans.
coverage.note: All 56 pages of the 25 March 1906 issue scanned: 337 numbered-address mentions. 271 are on the classified pages (pp. 46-53: to-let and for-sale want-ads, church notices, Berkeley and country land advertising, skipped on the precedent that want-ads carry nothing), 28 are a children's prize list of readers' home addresses (p. 16; people, never taken), 6 are in the p. 54 column, and the other 32 are advertisers' own offices, police items and out-of-town addresses; none of those is building news. The p. 54 column read whole: 77 items. Not taken: 2 out of town (Inverness, Madera; the Alameda County deed list below the column was not read for San Francisco), 24 vacant-lot sales in the Richmond, Sunset and Excelsior to private buyers, 22 sales of a lot, bare or 'with improvements', that name no building (the 1912 rule), and 3 bare leases of a floor or a store between private people. 26 findings: 2 resolved and published (957 Hayes, 2301 Folsom); 24 unresolved - 15 pre-fire in the burned district, 4 whose lot or corner matches no parcel with a roll year of 1906 or earlier, 3 with no offset or cross street, 1 notable past resident whose corner lot measures differently (Mrs. I. Magnin, NW Page and Masonic; 1099 Masonic the candidate), 1 a grading event on whole blocks.

resolution.method: No street number. Page's odd numbers are on its south side and Masonic's even numbers on its east side (EAS points), so the NW corner is assessor block 1223, west of Masonic and north of Page. Its only corner parcel is 1223004, 1099 Masonic Ave: the 2025 roll gives 1903, three storeys, 5,397 sq ft, but its sf-parcels outline measures 49.8 by 108.3 ft against the record's 57:6 by 100 (5,750 sq ft, 6% more). corner.py --batch (lot 57:6x100, built_by 1906) examined 1099 Masonic and refused it on area, and its one lot match, 1461 Page (1233032, 5,637.5 sq ft), is in the SE quadrant and dated 1910. A lot that measures and does not match is a refusal (LESSONS.md), so not placed; 1099 Masonic is the candidate if a directory of 1905-06 prints the house number.
resolution.note: Notable past resident - publishable as soon as the parcel is settled. The single-corner listing (corner.py PAGE MASONIC) omits 1099 Masonic, which sits outside its 60 m radius; the batch mode's wider radius includes it.

resolution.method: research/tools/corner.py --batch FOLSOM & 19TH ST, lot 25x100 = 2,500 sq ft, built_by 1906: two parcels match the area, 3593019 (2313 Folsom, 1900) and 3593021 (2301-2305 Folsom and 3187-3189 19th St, 1906). Block 3593 carries Folsom's odd numbers south of 19th (2300 Folsom, across the street, is block 3594; 3160 19th, across 19th, is block 3592), so it is the SE corner; of the two only 3593021 is addressed on 19th Street, i.e. the corner lot, and 2307 Folsom lies between it and 2313. Its five addresses and the roll's 'Flat & Store 5 to 14 units' match a store and four flats. Geometry agrees: 2301 Folsom's EAS point (37.760386, -122.414670) is south of 19th Street's centre (3160 19th, north side, at 37.760633; 3149 19th, south side, at 37.760290) and east of Folsom's (2300 Folsom, west side, at -122.415005). corner.py marks it WRONG SIDE only because its crossing estimate is the midpoint of 2301 Folsom and 3187 19th, inside this parcel; its centreline test passes. The roll's 1906 is the record's own year; the block face did not burn (2319-2331 Folsom on the same block are roll 1904).
